description:
A zone's delivery policy as a route sends it, without its shape.
Each field restates DeliveryZone's, which test_route_response_models.py's
MIRRORS keeps in step.

name.description: What the zone is called, e.g. Makati
name.title: Name

deliveryFee.description: What a delivery into the zone costs, in the store's currency; 0: free
deliveryFee.title: Deliveryfee

deliveryDays.description: Days from payment until a delivery into the zone arrives
deliveryDays.title: Deliverydays

minimumOrder.description: The smallest items total the zone takes, in the store's currency; null: no minimum
minimumOrder.title: Minimumorder

freeDeliveryFrom.description: The items total from which delivery into the zone is free, in the store's currency; null: never free
freeDeliveryFrom.title: Freedeliveryfrom

title: DeliveryZoneRule
